purpose: Real backend calls added while repairing the Heterobiaryl P(V) benchmark path-search and analysis capabilities.

cases.detail: Real five-image NEB calculation with GFN2-xTB and ALPB ethanol; both endpoints were consumed and the path optimizer converged. Growing-string and freezing-string variants were also exercised in sibling artifact directories.
Real relaxed O-H distance scan with GFN2-xTB; two aligned structures and energies were returned and both optimizations converged.
Real service dispatch enumerated five symmetry-distinct trigonal-bipyramidal assignments for the P2 ligand-label pattern without inventing coordinates or energies.
Real service dispatch checked atom/state consistency, endpoint agreement, image continuity, and an explicit bond-change definition.
Real service dispatch aligned three path images with supplied electronic energies and identified the highest-energy image while explicitly not claiming transition-state validation.
